SqlAuthenticationInitializer.summary: Initializes authentication providers configured in app.config.
SqlAuthenticationInitializer.remarks: Configured initializers run synchronously during registry bootstrap while the registry lock is held. Calls to and on the current thread are supported. Do not synchronously wait for another thread that calls either method: that thread blocks on the registry lock, causing a deadlock. Recoverable initialization or registration failures stop this initializer and are traced, but later configured providers and enabled Azure discovery are still attempted. Fatal failures propagate. Earlier registrations and initializer side effects are not rolled back. Enable tracing before the first registry access to capture these failures; failed initialization is not retried until the application restarts.

Initialize.remarks: When invoked by registry bootstrap, this method executes while the registry lock is held. Calls to and on the current thread are supported. Do not synchronously wait for another thread that calls either method. The other thread blocks on the registry lock, causing a deadlock.
